Definition: neuter singular of the comparative of G5036 (as adverb); more swiftly, i.e. (in manner) more rapidly, or (in time) more speedily:--out (run), quickly, shortly, sooner.
BiblicalUsage: John says the other disciple outran Peter to the tomb, running more swiftly; Jesus tells Judas, that thou doest, do quickly; and the writer of Hebrews hopes Timothy will be set at liberty shortly. The word is the comparative of swift: faster, sooner, more quickly. Each time it marks a race, an errand, or a wait coming to its end.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the footrace to the empty tomb is the happiest use of the word: two men running faster than they have ever run, toward news that changes everything.
RelatedPeople: John the Apostle; Simon Peter; Timothy
